brief: Allocate an irregular receipt across obligations due before the next reliable receipt.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Make an irregular receipt last"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Haz rendir una entrada irregular"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Faça uma entrada irregular durar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Allocate an irregular receipt across obligations due before the next reliable receipt.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Cover obligations before the next reliable receipt, not just this week.
instruction.misconception: Treating a large irregular receipt as spare money without checking how long it must cover required expenses.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: An irregular payment arrives today. List obligations due before the next reliable receipt before allocating anything else.
The money must last across the stated gap between receipts.
An unconfirmed receipt cannot support a definite spending commitment.
A longer gap can require the same money to cover more costs.
A seasonal receipt must be planned over the stated income gap.
